    Overview

    The Pro improves upon every detail that’s made our Ergonomic Chair the best-rated office chair on the internet. Featuring forward tilt adjustment, 5D armrests, two-way adjustable lumbar support, an optional headrest, and a wide assortment of premium materials, the Pro offers superlative support for every body at a remarkably accessible price. Learn more.

    • 14 points of adjustment
    • 5D adjustable armrests
    • Four premium materials
    • Cushioned two-way lumbar
    • Full workday (8+ hours)
    • Optional headrest

  • Benefits

    • 14 points of adjustment: our most configurable chair for every body
    • 5D armrests including arm width and height, as well as pad width, depth, and pivot
    • Height and depth adjustable lumbar support; completely removable
    • Seat height and depth, tilt and tilt tension, and forward seat tilt for precise alignment
    • Available in four materials: performance mesh with flocked super soft yarn, airy bouclé, scuff-resistant vegan leather, and luxurious leather
    • Optional headrest with two-axis adjustment
    • Optional extended cylinder to support taller heights
    • Meets BIFMA standard for commercial-grade use; supports 275 lbs
    • Designed by Branch in San Francisco, California

  • FAQ

    What are the differences between the Ergonomic Chair and the Ergonomic Chair Pro?
    The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers more adjustments, upgraded lumbar support, and premium material options. It’s designed for all-day comfort with added customization and enhanced support.

    Do ergonomic chairs help with back or posture issues?
    Ergonomic chairs feature adjustment points that support proper seated posture. The Ergonomic Chair Pro includes padded lumbar support and customizable armrests, so you can fine-tune your setup.

    Is a mesh or cushion chair better for long sitting?
    Mesh and cushion chairs both offer ergonomic support. Mesh is breathable and helps regulate temperature, while cushions provide a softer seat. The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers a breathable mesh back with a comfortable cushion seat.

    What materials are used in the Ergonomic Chair Pro’s construction?
    The Ergonomic Chair Pro is made with a powder-coated aluminum base, high-density foam cushioning, and your choice of fine-weave mesh, vegan leather, or premium leather upholstery.

    What is the weight capacity of the Ergonomic Chair Pro?
    The Ergonomic Chair Pro supports 275lbs.

Product details

Overview
Dimensions

A new era of ergonomics has arrived. Introducing Ergonomic Chair Pro, an unrivaled seating experience backed by half a decade of research, development, and testing with people who embody a wide variety of support needs and work styles. Designed by Branch in San Francisco, Ergonomic Chair Pro was meticulously (re)designed with the feedback of thousands of customers. It offers better customization, build quality, and materials to support productivity and well-being in the home, workplace, and anywhere work is done.

Led by designer Jesse Menayan, we wanted to create a flagship chair that not only matched but improved on the comfort and materiality of chairs that are twice the price. With 14 points of adjustment, an improved headrest, and an optional tall cylinder, Ergonomic Chair Pro offers superlative adjustability to fit every body. A choice of luxurious materials completes your daily sit, including super soft performance mesh, textured bouclé, durable vegan leather, or semi-aniline leather. Ergonomic Chair Pro is the culmination of our commitment to democratizing comfort and productivity in the workplace.

About the Collection

Ergonomic Collection

Three chairs, one commitment: every seat in the Ergonomic Collection is built around lasting, adjustable comfort at a price that makes sense. From your first real office chair to your executive level upgrade, find the right option for how you work.

The Ergonomic Chair Lite, Ergonomic Chair, and Ergonomic Chair Pro each share a high-density foam seat, aluminum base, and BIFMA-certified construction. Start with the Lite for focused adjustment at an accessible price, step up to the Ergonomic Chair for added lumbar and eight points of adjustment, or go all in with the Pro's 14 points and premium material options. Different levels of adjustment, the same commitment to how it's made.
